headline: Brazil Stocks Slip and Real Weakens as Global Markets Sell Off
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa fell 0.82% to 166,191 and the real weakened to R$5.49 per US dollar as Wall Street experienced a broad tech and stock sell-off.
why: Emerging market currencies and equity indices often track global risk sentiment, experiencing capital outflows during major Wall Street risk-off episodes.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Global risk-off sentiment and US market declines drove capital away from emerging market currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Negative spillover from the steep Wall Street sell-off prompted investors to trim risk exposure in Brazilian assets.
